verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a broad API of more than 120 actions. It covers domains, account settings, DNS, orders, registration, transfer, renewal, deletion, push, folders, aftermarket backorders and bids, and reseller management, so much of the UI surface is scriptable. However, nothing in the evidence states that the API matches everything the UI can do, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement; API coverage for UI features like SSL, email, watchlist, grace deletion and security settings; independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities. Our API supports more than 120 actions
Build your account by registering, transferring, and renewing domains through commands. You can even delete and push domains through our API.
Use our API to engage with our aftermarket - place backorder requests, discover new auction listings, place bids, and more.
Our API functions extend to our reseller program, allowing you to manage domains under your Dynadot reseller account efficiently.
